name: frontend-interface-design
description: Research and compose production-quality editable Figma product and landing designs from internal assets, templates, and verified references.

interface.shortDescription: Compose editable Figma designs from verified references
interface.longDescription: Turns PRDs, internal Figma assets, structured templates, Refero examples, and live product references into editable product or landing designs with a bounded visual critique loop and reusable component catalog.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PRD into an editable reference-driven Figma design.
Select a Figma template and build a three-section landing-page pilot.
Critique this Figma page and refine its three biggest visual problems.
